notes.title: v0.1.20 Playtest Update
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] A confirmation popup will now appear when selling high-quality phantasm beasts.
[*] Added a move button in the detailed view of a phantasm beast, allowing players to change its position.
[/list]
[h2]Optimizations / Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized the display of the phantasm beast’s range: when selecting a deployed beast, the affected farmland will now show a hint box.
[*] Improved default sorting of phantasm beasts, now from highest to lowest quality.
[*] Optimized behavior when phantasm beasts are moved behind buildings.
[*] Reduced lag when selling phantasm beasts.
[*] Improved filter functionality.
[*] Fixed a bug where beast names were displayed repeatedly.
[*] Fixed an issue related to range-based talents.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.11 Playtest Update
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to right-click to cancel the pet range setting when capturing a pet
[/list]
[h2]Adjustments / Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a freezing issue when pressing the F1 or F2 keys
[*]Fixed an issue where the Wishing Star Phantom Beast could not be claimed by clicking the wishlist
[*] Relocated the “Clear Save” button and added a secondary confirmation screen
[*]Adjusted building center positions for better alignment and consistency
[*]Fixed an issue where mushrooms around buildings could not be selected
[*]Optimized the shovel’s crop removal behavior
[*] Fixed visual glitches at the edges of farmland
[*]Fixed an issue where mushrooms would revert to stage one after restarting the game
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.7 Playtest Update
notes.notes:
Welcome all players to try out the game! Click to join the Playtest! We will continue to update and optimize, striving to deliver a better gaming experience for everyone.

Here are the update notes for Version 0.1.7 Playtest!

[h2]Optimizations & Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Farmland Tiles:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where gaps could appear around the edges of farmland plots.
[/list]
[h3]Warehouse Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where moving the warehouse would allow unlimited crop selling.
[*] Fixed a bug where error messages would constantly display inside the warehouse UI.
[/list]
[h3]Building Unlock Issues:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where already unlocked buildings would still appear in the locked list.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Fusion Center could not be unlocked properly.
[*] Fixed a bug where certain fusion buildings were not unlocking as expected.
[/list]
[h3]Crop Progress Display:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where crop unlock progress did not show specific values.
[/list]
[h3]UI Adjustments:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Moved buttons such as the player survey to the Settings menu for easier access.
[/list]
[h2]🔥Jump in and add to your wishlist right away![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3659410/_/

Thank you to everyone who joined the Playtest! We’re looking forward to hearing your feedback and suggestions. Join our community and share your thoughts with us!
